verses.1: For there will be a quarrel between people, and they will go before the judge. Then he will judge them fairly: he will do justice to the righteous and punish the wicked.
verses.2: And if the wicked child were to be punished, and the judge to strike him before his eyes, so that his wickedness might be recorded in the book.
verses.3: Forty people will not be able to do anything; they won’t be able to harm them at all. Your brothers will be safe in your eyes.
verses.4: Do not close the door in a hurry.
verses.5: When brothers live together, and one of them dies, then the son has no right to marry the widow of the deceased. A foreign man will come and take her as his wife.
verses.6: And the successor who would be born in his place would rise up in the name of his deceased brother. His name would not be forgotten among the people of Israel.
verses.7: And if the man does not hurry to take his wife away, then his wife will go to the elders. She will say, “Where can I find a place in Israel where I can build a house for my brother? There is no place for me here.”
verses.8: And the elders of the city called to him, and said to him, “Do not take her away.” But he stood up and said, “I do not want to take her away.”
verses.9: And she went to him, in front of the elders. She took off his clothes from his body. Then she wiped his face with a towel. She said, “This is what will happen to those who do not build their own homes.”
verses.10: And its name will be called “Beit Chalutz HaNa’al” in Israel.
verses.11: For people may be separated from each other, one man and his brother. Then the wife of one of them will go to save her husband from those who are attacking him. She will reach out with her hand and hold onto his arm.
verses.12: And cut off its head; do not let your eyes see it.
verses.13: There will be no stone or large or small stone in your bag.
verses.14: There will be no place in your house where there are large and small things.
verses.15: May holiness and righteousness be your portion. Wherever holiness and righteousness are found, there will your days be prolonged upon the land that Jehovah your God has given you.
verses.16: For the wrath of the LORD your God is terrible; all these people will be destroyed.
verses.17: Remember what Amalek did to you on your way out of Egypt.
verses.18: “For you have gone down the wrong path, and all those who were around you have strayed from the right path. And you, too, are lost and suffering, without fearing God.”
verses.19: And it shall be that when Jehovah your God brings you out of all your troubles around you, from all the enemies who surround you in this land, and gives you a possession to inherit, then you shall erase the memory of Amalek from under heaven forever. Do not forget it.
